lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn10Cr2N12 (Mn5CrN6) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 119), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cr centers in octahedral N coordination, while Mn centers display both octahedral and lower-coordinate N environments. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates edge-sharing between Cr octahedra and between Cr and Mn octahedra.
